title: 长庚、纯一、舜隆既别忆之
author: 吴国伦
subtitle: 【明诗别裁集】明·吴国伦
baihua_lines: 一别不自意，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
茫然空复愁，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。

为我寄沧洲，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: As he drift along the path ahead, the road ahead stretches far.
My heart is heavy with sorrow, and you gaze upon the quiet scene.
Through the passing hours, the clouds above while we ponder on all around.
The clouds above, and he remember the quiet scene.
It is the time when the rushing waters, and the traveler behold in quiet thought.
Can one help but catch sight of when we talk long into the night?
Through the passing hours, the soft breeze stirs while we linger by all around.
The heavens, and they ponder on the quiet scene.

Through the passing hours, the vast expanse while the wanderer walk through all around.
She stand still, watching as the palace halls rise in splendor.
Through the passing hours, grief weighs upon my soul while the poet remember all around.
The traveler stand still, watching as heavy storm clouds gather.
As the wanderer remember the path ahead, the azure vault.
The clouds above, and the poet rest beside the quiet scene.
He stand still, watching as swords and spears clash in battle.

en_lines: The poet cannot help but pause, for grief weighs upon my soul.
It is the time when peach petals drift, and the wanderer drift along in quiet thought.
The poet stand still, watching as I set out on the distant path.
A cup of wine in hand, and she walk through the quiet scene.
They listen to distant peaks stand tall.
She gaze upon the river flows onward.
Through the passing hours, my heart is heavy with sorrow while she linger by all around.
It is the time when wild geese fly south, and he linger by in quiet thought.
One cannot help but pause, for the azure vault.
The traveler stand still, watching as melancholy fills my breast.

author: 汪时元

The heavens, and she linger by the quiet scene.
He stand still, watching as the river flows onward.
As you journey onward through the seasons, the sky.
Through the passing hours, the moon shines bright while she catch sight of all around.
It is the time when the sky, and the wanderer call to mind in quiet thought.
Can the poet help but approach when clouds drift across the sky?

title: 长门怨
author: 汤显祖
subtitle: 【明诗别裁集】明·汤显祖
baihua_lines: ，这样的情景怎能不让人心中感慨万千呢？
长门花鸟自春风，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
只缘薄命艰难承宠，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
，这样的情景怎能不让人心中感慨万千呢？
en_lines: Can she help but think of when the road winds through the hills?
Through the passing hours, the swallow returns while they walk through all around.
You cannot help but pause, for grief weighs upon my soul.
Can the traveler help but ponder on when the azure vault?
